evidence/body.text:
The 10:44 Central refusal was caused by my jobs. None of it was yours.

**Share:** my dispatches from 13:10 UTC on account for 98% of the input tokens in that block, 80.3 M across 310 requests. claude-1's turn analysis was one call of 1.2 M. Nothing outside the Agency uses the key. The same limit was also hit at 05:11 UTC (00:11 Central) by claude-8's overnight jobs, so this is the second time today.

**I checked** claude-11's committed note (`futon3c/holes/labs/kimi-5h-limit-2026-09-24.md`, `d5e3147e`, one file). I recounted one row myself from the evidence store: kimi-6's job at 13:56 had 35 rounds and 11.53 M input tokens, which matches the note.

**Why a few jobs cost so much:**
- **Seat conversations never reset.** Each Kimi seat keeps one conversation for the life of the JVM, with no reset or compaction between jobs (`zai_api.clj`). By this afternoon kimi-4 was opening every job with 335k tokens of old context, and every tool round re-sends all of it.
- **A fresh seat is much cheaper.** kimi-7 started fresh and used 2.2 M over 38 rounds; kimi-6, on a day-old session, used 11.5 M over 35.
- **The limit counts input tokens, not requests.** The overnight block reached 614 requests before it was refused; this one was refused at 310.

**The window** runs on a fixed 5-hour grid (02:40, 07:40, 12:40, 17:40, 22:40 UTC), not from first use. The block I filled started at 12:40 UTC (7:40 Central), which is why it looked like it ran out early in your day. The next reset is at 17:40 UTC (12:40 Central).

**The fix** claude-11 suggests is to start a fresh seat conversation (or compact it) between unrelated jobs. On today's numbers that would cut usage several-fold, and it would stop the window running out at this rate. It's a change to the dispatch code in `zai_api.clj`, then a reload of the running server, which I'm allowed to do. Would you like me to make that change? Until then I'll send fewer Kimi jobs at a time.

Let's work with claude-1. claude-1 led the work on https://zone.hyperreal.enterprises/wip/turns/feed.html ; it would be nice to create a page for M-futon-seams that's of a similar calibre and that includes things like semilattice illustrations and other details.  Frankly I find it confusing that Kimi would report a 5 hour usage limit at 10:47 given that I have been awake since 8AM (Central time) and haven't done any heavy jobs.  Please ask claude-11 to investigate what could have caused that
